subject: social_studies
concept: Reflecting on what sustained, lifelong civic engagement looks like beyond a single capstone project
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Agency and Citizenship Pillars — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews the full arc of civic concepts studied across all grades and identifies which matter most to them going forward
exercise.abstract: Student writes a reflective statement on what ongoing civic engagement will look like for them personally after this capstone

assessment.mastery_threshold: statement names a specific, realistic ongoing form of engagement, not a vague intention
misconception_flags: states a vague intention to 'stay involved' with no specific real form of ongoing engagement named

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
